parsed.name: Newport ESP300多轴运动控制器
parsed.description: 这是一台用于驱动和控制多轴电动位移台或旋转台的实验室运动控制器，常见于显微镜、光学平台和精密定位系统中，用于样品、物镜或光学元件的精确移动与定位。
parsed.description_en: This is a laboratory multi-axis motion controller used to drive motorized translation or rotation stages. It is commonly used in microscopes, optical benches, and precision positioning setups to move and position samples, objectives, or optical components accurately.
